Respected Amazon Support Team,
I am writing to express my extreme dissatisfaction with an iPhone 15 (Pink) that I purchased from Amazon on October 2nd, 2025.
I am facing severe hardware issues with the device which indicate that the product delivered to me was structurally defective from the start:
Display Issue: A black dot has appeared on the screen. Initially, it was minor, but it is now slowly increasing in size, making the phone difficult to use.
Structural Defects: I visited the official Apple Service Center to claim the warranty. However, the technicians there pointed out that the phone's body is slightly bent and there is a visible gap in the antenna line.
No User Damage: I want to clarify with absolute confidence that the phone has never been dropped, mishandled, or subjected to any pressure. There are zero scratches or cracks on the screen or body. The Apple Service Center has suggested that these are structural/manufacturing defects or transit damages that were present at the time of delivery.

I purchased an iPhone on 25th September and received it the same day, thanks to my Prime membership. While the delivery experience was excellent, unfortunately, the product turned out to be defective.

Soon after using the phone, I noticed a camera issue, so I visited the Venus Apple Store. The Apple technicians confirmed the defect and mentioned that the only available option was to repair the device, which would take about 4–5 days. Since I do not have a spare phone, I requested a replacement instead and contacted Amazon for support.

After spending significant time reaching your support team, I was informed that I needed to provide a denial letter from Apple confirming that the device was defective and replacement should be issued. Apple, however, provided a delivery report clearly stating the defect and the reason, which I shared with Amazon. This document was initially accepted, but later I was informed that it was not acceptable and that a “denial letter” was still required.

Apple has confirmed that they do not issue denial letters, and the delivery report is the only official document they can provide regarding a verified defect. When I requested Amazon to send a written rejection or acknowledgment via email, I was told that there is no email address available for such communication.

I have now reached a point where, despite following every instruction from both Apple and Amazon, I have no resolution. I kindly request Amazon to take ownership of this matter and arrange a replacement or full refund for the defective product at the earliest. All official documentation confirming the defect has already been provided.

I trust @amazon will treat this case with urgency and help restore confidence in the customer experience.

Subject: Immediate Action Required: Tampered iPhone 15 Delivered by Amazon – Request for Replacement

Message:

Dear Amazon Customer Support,

I am writing to raise a serious concern regarding a defective Apple iPhone 15 that I purchased through Amazon’s Best Choice listing.

Delivery Date: 25th May 2025

Issue Detected: 5th June 2025

The phone functioned normally for a few days but suddenly stopped working — the display went completely black and is now unusable. I visited an Apple Authorized Service Centre the next day, where I was informed that the issue could be due to either a damaged part or potential tampering.

What’s even more troubling is that Apple has clearly stated that if any part of the phone has been tampered with, they will refuse to service it altogether. Even if not, the phone needs to be sent to Bangalore, which will take a minimum of 10 days, leaving me without a working phone for an unacceptable period of time.

Let me be clear:
I purchased this phone in good faith from Amazon, relying on your platform’s guarantee of authenticity and your “Best Choice” recommendation. If this device has non-genuine or tampered parts, the responsibility lies entirely with Amazon and/or the seller.

I therefore demand:

1. A full investigation into the authenticity of the phone delivered to me.

2. If any tampering is confirmed, an immediate replacement with a brand-new, untampered unit.

3. Compensation or at the very least a temporary solution, considering the serious inconvenience this has caused.

I expect a response and resolution within 48 hours, failing which I will be forced to escalate this matter further.
and am happy to provide documentation from the Apple Service Centre if required .
